chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Contentment is a wealth that does not exhaust.

key_terms.الْقَنَاعَةُ: Contentment, satisfaction with what one has
key_terms.لَا يَنْفَدُ: That does not exhaust or run out

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic definition of true wealth?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) defines contentment (al-qana'ah) as an inexhaustible form of wealth, contrasting it with material possessions that are depleted through use or loss. In Shia scholarly tradition, this maxim highlights the spiritual autonomy of the believer, where inner satisfaction serves as a perpetual source of richness independent of external circumstances. This concept underscores the ethical ideal of sufficiency, linking material restraint with spiritual abundance.
